Hi Mira —

Thanks for sending these over and for moving quickly. Quick answers up front:

- Invoice format: we can accept either line-level tax or consolidated VAT summary, but to avoid PO matching issues please include the deal id (DL-2024-0877) in the PO number field. Our billing system will reconcile faster if the PO references the committed spend deal id.
- VAT evidence: we need a PDF VAT certificate and a company registration number. If Brightlane has a local tax agent letter, include it too.

I've copied Kimberly (billing ops) and Priyom (account lead) to confirm the invoice template and provide a Redwood sample invoice (attached). Priyom — can you confirm the billing alias we want on the invoice (for remit / ACH)?

Next steps for procurement:
1) Procurement attaches PO to a short email referencing DL-2024-0877 and the total prepay amount.
2) Send PO + VAT cert to billing@redwood.com.
3) Redwood will issue sample invoice within 24 hours and kick the drawdown schedule once funds are confirmed.

I'll follow up with a concise checklist they can paste into their procurement request.

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi all,

Laura's guidance is spot on. For remit details, please use the billing alias: prepay-ops@redwood.com and include the following on the PO to avoid processing delays:
- Deal ID: DL-2024-0877
- Currency: USD
- Total prepay amount and expected drawdown cadence (we generally prefer monthly drawdowns tied to usage but can do milestone-based reductions per the PO)

Suggested drawdown cadence (proposed):
- Initial activation invoice on receipt of funds (covers first 30 days)
- Monthly token/consumption invoices against the committed balance, with weekly usage export if requested

Kimberly / Hannah, can you confirm acceptable evidence for VAT reclaims and whether Brightlane needs any special tax routing (e.g., EU VAT handling if they have EU subsidiaries)?

Thanks,
Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Mira —

Quick checklist from billing ops for procurement to paste into the PO email:
- PO Number: include Deal ID DL-2024-0877 in the PO number field
- Currency: USD (unless your AP requires EUR — flag if so)
- Attachments: VAT certificate (PDF), company registration number, contact for remit (email + phone)
- Invoice expectation: we will issue an initial activation invoice upon receipt of cleared funds and the attached PO; follow-on invoices issued monthly against committed balance.
- Accounting notes: Redwood supports a line-level VAT breakdown or consolidated VAT summary. If Brightlane needs specific tax codes on the invoice, include them in the PO notes.

Attached: sample invoice (the one Laura sent) and a short PDF we use for VAT evidence mapping. If you can return the PO with the three items above we'll queue for immediate processing.

[Attachment: redwood_sample_invoice_v2.xlsx; Attachment: vat_evidence_mapping_guide.pdf]

Regards,
